title: Unified machine learning tasks and datasets for enhancing renewable energy

bias_targets.methodology: Measured using the Sample Imbalance score (SImb-score) to quantify data imbalances and sample biases that a model sees during training, validation, and testing. It computes the average Jensen-Shannon divergence (JSD) between the distribution of each input feature and a uniform distribution.

Measured using the Outlier-score to capture the presence of insufficiently evaluated subgroups and edge cases. It applies the Tukey's fences method (using the interquartile range) to identify and score exceptional values and outliers in the data without imposing assumptions about the underlying distribution.
